_disclaimer: SIMULATED DEMONSTRATION POLICY -- NOT A CLINICAL GOVERNANCE STANDARD. These settings describe how a prototype handles acuity changes. A real department would set them with its clinical governance lead, not inherit ours.
_the_rule: The engine may raise a band. The engine may never lower one. Only a nurse can de-escalate, and only with a reason that goes on the record under their name. Everything in this file is about the second half of that sentence, because the first half needs no configuration -- it is enforced by the absence of a code path.
_why_reasons_are_asymmetric: An escalation already carries its justification: the contribution trace, the confidence panel and any rule firing are all on the record, and demanding the nurse type an explanation for the machine's own decision would be theatre. A de-escalation is the opposite. It overrides evidence the system has recorded, so the person overriding it supplies the missing piece. Requiring a reason in only one direction is not an oversight.

override._rejected_reasons_note: Strings that pass a length check while saying nothing. A free-text box that accepts 'fine' has documented nothing and creates a false audit trail, which is worse than no audit trail because it looks like accountability. This list is short, case-insensitive, and matched whole -- it is a guard against reflex, not an attempt to judge clinical writing.
override._acknowledge_note: When the current band was set by a Phase 7 safety rule rather than by the score, the nurse is shown that rule and their override must acknowledge it. They are still free to disagree -- a rule is a floor for the machine, not for a clinician -- but they should not be able to remove a floor without seeing what put it there.
override._multi_band_note: A drop of more than one band in a single action is permitted but flagged for review. We do not block it: a nurse who has just examined a patient may well have information that moves them two levels, and a system that forces them to click twice has achieved nothing except a worse record of what they actually decided.

_history_note: Phase 8 keeps band history in memory so the ratchet has something to compare against. Phase 9 replaces this with a real append-only audit log; the transition records below are already shaped for it.
